purpose: Instrumentation viability only; no acceptance ratio or long campaign
windowStart: First observed physically battery-only AND screen noninteractive sample
wholeSessionBoundary: Battery-only discharge delimited by physical unplug/replug; sampler 600s subwindow reported separately; AccuBattery whole-session totals cannot be treated as exact subwindow totals

controls.bluetooth: OFF; restore original ON after probes
controls.fixture: Same stationary room, quiet, no external playback generated; owner asked to leave device unused

batteryOptimization: No exemptions added to DORA or AccuBattery; record any monitoring loss
sourceSelectionRule: Validated charge counter with meaningful repeatable delta
Validated AccuBattery controller-derived session discharge estimate
Batterystats estimated UID attribution with explicit limitations
percentageRole: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; never converted to charge or energy
attemptRetention: Preserve all attempts; invalid/unknown data never converted to zero or removed
baselineWindowBinding: B is classified as active baseline only if its unique successful AudioRecord receipt covers first sample through last snapshot, with zero read errors, built-in microphone and matching PCM format. Automatic baseline stop before window end invalidates B coverage.
terminalBinding: Every measured row must share probeId/windowStartMs; exactly one consistent END is required for candidate charge delta. Missing, contradictory or mixed receipts never become candidate consumption.
batterystatsResetCaveat: POCO reset emitted a UID SecurityException despite observed new epoch/zero counters. Retain both; do not claim error-free reset or bypass security. Physical window independently logged.
privacy: Full system dumps stay local. Publication allowlist retains only target UIDs and content-free counters; no audio or private identifiers.
changeReason: A-02 shell sampler stopped before physical window; replace shell lifetime with Android self-target instrumentation; retain A-01/A-02

observer.lifetime: Android self-target instrumentation; no -w ADB watcher
observer.usbSmoke: SMOKE-01: 3 samples; not physical discharge evidence
limitations: May prevent process-idle killing; identical observer required across all A/B/C probes
Batterystats history required beyond periodic screen/power observations
